notes: Photographs (2021-08) predate the tenant record, so the tenant gets a plain board with the record name. Removed the window repeat that fell inside the corner bay and the one overlapping the fire-escape windows. The upper floors in the middle and right are largely hidden by trees, so window rhythms there are carried through. The second bay's position (about u 17) is approximate. The neighbouring shop names are unreadable. | Upper windows are now listed per floor at v 5.0, 8.4 and 11.6, because repeat only works along the wall. The magnolia tree hides u 9-19 on the lowest upper floor. Those windows and the corner pair are carried from the rows visible in the grid image and photo 3. Photos show ground floor plus three upper floors. The small text on the DELI board is unreadable and left out.
